title: Demystifying Artificial Intelligence
summary: The book provides an overview of the different AI technologies, demystifying terms such as search, reasoning, learning, adapting, understanding, and interacting. It covers the two dominant paradigms in AI, both the “data-driven” and “symbolic” AI systems, showing how they can complement each other. The theory is illustrated with 22 real-world examples from industry, giving a solid understanding of AI concepts, applicability, and limitations.
